help:
Usage: persona [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage the persona identity

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  show          Show full persona configuration.
  update        Update persona fields.
  personality   Print or modify the personality document.
  name          Show or set the persona's display name.
  instructions  Print, modify, or export DB-backed heartbeat instructions.
  preview       Show the effective runtime prompt/context preview for Jenny.
  heartbeat     Trigger a heartbeat.
  activity      Show recent persona activity sessions.
  status        Show heartbeat state and persona overview.
help.show:
Usage: persona show [OPTIONS]

  Show full persona configuration.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.update:
Usage: persona update [OPTIONS]

  Update persona fields. Text fields accept file paths.

Options:
  -H, --heartbeat-instructions <str>
                                  Import heartbeat instructions from file into
                                  DB
  -U, --user-context <str>        File with user context
  --voice-enabled / --no-voice    Toggle voice
  --voice-id <str>                Voice ID string
  --heartbeat-interval <int>      Minutes between heartbeats (0-1440)
  --session-reset-mode <str>      off, daily, or idle
  --session-reset-hour <int>      Hour (0-23) for daily reset
  --greeting <str>                Greeting message
  --limits <str>                  JSON file for limits
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
help.personality:
Usage: persona personality [OPTIONS]

  Print or modify the personality document.

Options:
  -e, --edit       Open $EDITOR to modify personality
  -s, --set <str>  Set personality text directly
  --help           Show this message and exit.
help.name:
Usage: persona name [OPTIONS] [new_name]

  Show or set the persona's display name.

Arguments:
  new_name  New name for the persona

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.instructions:
Usage: persona instructions [OPTIONS]

  Print, modify, or export DB-backed heartbeat instructions.

Options:
  -e, --edit       Open $EDITOR to modify
  -s, --set <str>  Set heartbeat instructions directly
  --export <str>   Export DB-backed heartbeat instructions to file
  --help           Show this message and exit.
help.preview:
Usage: persona preview [OPTIONS]

  Show the effective runtime prompt/context preview for Jenny.

Options:
  -m, --mode <str>     Preview mode: chat, heartbeat, wake, review  [default:
                       heartbeat]
  -P, --project <str>  Optional project scope
  --phase <str>        Optional phase/event hint
  --input <str>        Optional prompt input placeholder
  --json               Print raw JSON response
  --combined-only      Print only the full combined context
  --show-content       Print full section bodies plus full context.
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.heartbeat:
Usage: persona heartbeat [OPTIONS]

  Trigger a heartbeat. With --watch, poll until it finishes.

Options:
  -w, --watch          Poll until heartbeat completes
  -P, --project <str>  Target project for this manual heartbeat
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.activity:
Usage: persona activity [OPTIONS]

  Show recent persona activity sessions.

Options:
  -H, --hours <int>  Lookback hours (default 24)  [default: 24]
  -n, --limit <int>  Max sessions to show  [default: 10]
  --help             Show this message and exit.
help.status:
Usage: persona status [OPTIONS]

  Show heartbeat state and persona overview.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

usage.when: inspect or manage the Agent Hub persona

argv:
import json
from st_sdk.runtime import describe_app
from agent_hub_st.__main__ import OWNED_APPS
print(json.dumps(describe_app(OWNED_APPS['persona'], 'persona')))
